5/ This is why we built Newton: an authorization layer before settlement. Policies checked per transaction by an operator network, cryptographic attestation, signed receipt onchain. Legible to allocators and regulators without exposing positions.
4/ What allocators now ask curators isn’t “what’s your risk framework?” It’s “what enforces it when you’re asleep, when the bot is running?” Documentation is no longer an answer.

3/ November 2025 made the gap clear. One curation failure produced roughly $285M in contagion while automated allocators kept executing into the collapse. Not an information failure. An enforcement failure.
2/ Settlement is verifiable. Yield is verifiable. But the mandates allocators actually underwrite still live in PDFs and docs.
